title: Flat affine base change for sections on intersections of quasi-compact opens
statement:
Let $R$ and $T$ be commutative rings with a homomorphism $R\to T$, and suppose $\operatorname{Spec}T\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ is flat [def-weil-affine-spectrum, def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $Y\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism], let $Y_T=Y\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}\operatorname{Spec}T$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and write $g:Y_T\to Y$ for the projection. Let $E\subset |Y|$ be an intersection of a nonempty set-indexed family of quasi-compact opens, and set $E_T=g^{-1}(E)$. Give these subsets their subspace topologies and let $\mathcal O_Y|_E$ and $\mathcal O_{Y_T}|_{E_T}$ mean inverse-image sheaves along their inclusions. Then the canonical homomorphism of $T$-algebras
$$\Gamma(E,\mathcal O_Y|_E)\otimes_R T\ \xrightarrow{\sim}\ \Gamma(E_T,\mathcal O_{Y_T}|_{E_T}),\qquad c\otimes t\longmapsto g^\sharp(c)\,t$$
is an isomorphism. These canonical maps are natural for isomorphisms of the schemes with their indicated subsets, and commute with iterated flat affine base change and tensor-product associativity.
